load_config_from_pretrained: load a PretrainedConfig from a pretrained model name or directory path using from_pretrained
save_config_pretrained: save a PretrainedConfig instance to a directory as a JSON file using save_pretrained
create_config_from_dict: create a PretrainedConfig from a Python dictionary of parameters using from_dict
load_config_from_json: load a PretrainedConfig from a JSON file of parameters using from_json_file
serialize_config_to_json: serialize a PretrainedConfig instance to a JSON string or file using to_json_string or to_json_file
